messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER (sev3) — metric: billing.emitter.kv_prefix_latency > 5m for last 10m. Shadow aggregates behind; customers receiving transient overage flags. Oncall: @alex.ng

alex.ng: seeing the alert, digging into emitter logs now. can someone check shadow ledger lag?

samira: checking ledger. shadow-agg consumer lag: consumer_group=ledger-processor lag=1,920,754 tokens behind (approx). recent commits show emitter retry storm 04:02-04:08 UTC.

alex.ng: OK. first mitigation: pause emitter retries to prevent amplification, and enable fallback aggregator (read-only prefix) to let counts flow to billing. running commands now:
```
kubectl -n billing exec deploy/metering-emitter -- sh -c 'curl -XPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/pause-retries'
kubectl -n billing patch deploy meter-aggregator -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"reconcile-timestamp":"1680303030"}}}}}'
```

ops-lead: @emma-finance cc'd. I'll open a customer impact note once we have rough numbers.

infra-bot: rollout status: deployment "meter-aggregator" patched — new replica set created (1/3 ready).

samira: aggregator pods coming up, but consumer backlog still present. planning a short consumer scale-up to drain the queue faster.

oncall: check if this will double-count while backfilling (we had a duplicate-ack risk last time).

alex.ng: good call. we'll run the backfill in read-only mode and mark events with backfill_id so downstream dedupe runs. also toggling safe-mode in billing-service to suppress transient overage flags for customers while reconciliation in progress.

emma-finance: estimate of affected customers? need to know if customer billing notices should be paused.

samira: quick estimate from last hour: ~2.1% of active accounts saw a conservative +5-10% spike in token flags due to delayed emit. top affected customers are internal staging and ~7 small production customers (IDs redacted).

ops-lead: action items: 1) @alex.ng pause retries (done) 2) @samira scale consumers (pending) 3) infra to monitor aggregator rollout 4) finance/CS to hold billing emails 5) create postmortem-runbook task.

alex.ng: consumer scale command (running):
```
kubectl -n billing scale deployment ledger-processor --replicas=8
```

infra-bot: ledger-processor scaled to 8 replicas — pods scheduling.

samira: backlog drain rate after scale ~120k tokens/min vs 18k before. projected catch-up ~16 minutes. continuing to watch for duplicate emissions.

oncall: for customer-facing messaging, do not mention tokens. say "intermittent billing visibility delay" and that no charges will be applied until reconciliation completes. finance OK?

emma-finance: agree. please hold any automated overage emails. I'll send a one-off note to CS leaders with impact summary and estimated window (30m).

alex.ng: monitoring metrics: token_emit_rate normalized, k-v latency dropping. disabling safe-mode after confirmation.

samira: tail of emitter logs shows a single client generating burst retries — traced to proxy config rollback at 03:58 UTC. adding a throttling rule to proxy as a longer-term fix.

ops-lead: status update for oncall handoff: mitigation in place, backlog draining, customer notices paused. handing to the night team at 04:50 UTC for watch. please create follow-up task to remediate retry logic and add detection rule for sudden retry waves.

alex.ng: creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2431 — summary: emitter retry storm -> ledger lag -> transient overage flags. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-platform.

pagerduty-bot: PAGER resolved (alert cleared) — billing.emitter.kv_prefix_latency back under threshold for 5m.

ops-lead: thanks team. quick retro notes in thread: 1) auto-suppress overage emails during reconciliation windows 2) add circuit-breaker in emitter to avoid retry storms 3) tighten proxy rollback checks 4) run customer-impact audit and refund playbook if needed.

emma-finance: noted. please include per-customer token delta in the postmortem so finance can assess refunds/credits.

alex.ng: will attach logs, replay hashes, and the backfill_id to the ticket. handing off to @oncall for monitoring through the night.

oncall: taking handoff. I'll check the backlog every 15m and escalate if drift reappears. good call everyone. :thumbsup:
